title.purpose: The page heading inside the editor.

mono.purpose: Ids, logs, keys, and the status bar.

shadows.name: palette
shadows.purpose: The command palette. Offset and neutral blur.

motion.name: palette-in
motion.purpose: The palette enters already visible and moves 8px down.

motion.name: caret
motion.purpose: The editor caret blinks. It stays solid when motion is reduced.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The action that opens the console.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4c9aff; color: #061018; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 500 13px/1.45 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #79b6ff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #e8e8e8; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions on the editor surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #0e0e0e; color: #e8e8e8; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 0; font: 400 13px/1.45 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #161616; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #4c9aff; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0e0e0e; color: #e8e8e8; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 0; font: 400 13px/1.45 'Public Sans', sans-serif; caret-color: #4c9aff; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b8b8b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #4c9aff; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Ready mark
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 400 12px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-status i { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: currentColor; } .ds-status-ready { color: #3fb950; }

components.name: Activity link
components.description: One section in the activity rail.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; color: #8b8b8b; text-decoration: none; font: 400 12px/1 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-rail:hover { background: #161616; color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-rail[aria-current='page'] { background: #16325c; color: #4c9aff; } .ds-rail:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #4c9aff; outline-offset: -1px; }

narrative.overview: Origin is the console, already open. The first screen is an editor buffer named session.origin, with sample deploy output beside it and a status bar under it. The visitor does not pass through a marketing hero.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal editor ground, a darker rail and sidebar, and 1px hairlines.
Electric blue only for the caret, focus, selection, and the primary action.
Green, red, and amber only for deploy and log state.
Monospace for identifiers, logs, and the status bar. Public Sans for the UI.
Sharp corners. No glow, no glass, no card grid.

rules.name: The State Rule
rules.body: Color carries status. Ready is #3fb950, failed is #f85149, building and queued are #d29922. Blue is focus, not a fourth status.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Corner radius is 0. Status marks are squares. Focus is a 1px inset outline in #4c9aff, and a 1px ink outline on the blue button.

dos: Do label fixtures as sample data.
Do keep the AWS Singapore plan in the future tense until an account is connected.
donts: Don't print the AWS account id.
Don't invent customers, prices, or benchmarks.
Don't round the shell into cards, add glow, or cover the ground with glass.
